_README.description: Zhipu GLM via the Z.ai OpenAI-compatible API (native provider, ZAI_API_KEY).
_README.aa_version: The aa_index and aa_index_by_effort values here come from the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5.0.1 (leaderboard read 2026-11-11). Entries without them carry estimated or v4.3-based scores; each description says which. Change this line at each AA regrade.
_README.usage: Base URL https://api.z.ai/api/paas/v4. GLM-5.3 is API-only (open weights delayed), so this direct route is the way to reach the latest GLM. Scores pinned to the z-ai/* OpenRouter mirrors. Verify model IDs against /models if a call 404s.

models.description: Zhipu GLM-5.3 - flagship reasoning/coding MoE (API-only; open weights staged). Direct Z.ai API. AA Intelligence Index v5: low 23, max 32. Score at the high-effort anchor is interpolated: AA has no high row, so high is taken as about 27.
Zhipu GLM-5.3 Flash - native multimodal MoE (320B/18B, 1M context, AA Intelligence Index v5 28, one row, read 2026-11-10; v4.3 was 42). Flash sibling of GLM-5.3, direct Z.ai API.
Zhipu GLM-4.6 - prior flagship. Direct Z.ai API.
